name: setRemoveIf
description: Removes every element for which the callback returns true. Returns true if any element was removed.

params.name: callback
params.description: Function that receives each element and returns true to remove it.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists.
